content.en: Scientists have been exploring the use of algorithms to predict various properties of wood, such as density and species identification, using near-infrared spectroscopy. These algorithms, such as least square-support vector machine (LS-SVM), nonlinear partial least square (NPLS), and artificial neural network, are combined with different techniques to analyze the data and make accurate predictions. By harnessing the power of machine learning, researchers hope to improve our understanding of wood properties and enhance the efficiency of wood-related industries.
content.da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer til at forudsige forskellige egenskaber ved træ, såsom densitet og artsidentifikation, ved hjælp af nær-infrarød spektroskopi. Disse algoritmer, såsom least square-support vector machine (LS-SVM), nonlinear partial least square (NPLS) og artificial neural network, kombineres med forskellige teknikker for at analysere dataene og lave præcise forudsigelser. Ved at udnytte kraften fra machine learning håber forskerne at forbedre vores forståelse af trækegenskaber og øge effektiviteten i trærelaterede industrier.

critic.en: Even my "character-conscious" self cringes at the idea that machines could do better than humans when it comes to understanding nature. Why do we want to use algorithms to predict wood properties ? Because it is trendy. Tech reproduces the most evil aspect of humans: they want to control everything. Please, do not see digitalization as a solution for everything.
critic.da: Ah, tragikomisk nok er teknologien nu også kommet til dominere i skoven. Vi skal "forstå" og "forbedre effektiviteten" gennem algoritmer. Fiasko! Hvorfor respektere den organiske kompleksitet, når du kan bytte den ud med en algoritme?

potential.en: This is a great example of how technology can be used to enhance our understanding of natural resources and improve industrial processes. By using machine learning algorithms to predict wood properties, researchers can help ensure sustainable management of forests and meet the growing demand for wood products in a more efficient way. I find it fascinating how something as traditional as woodworking can be elevated and modernized through the application of digital tools. Just as a carpenter relies on a well-organized workshop to create quality furniture, the integration of algorithms and spectroscopy can provide the insights and accuracy needed to make informed decisions in the wood industry.
potential.da: Det er fantastisk, hvordan algoritmer kan hjælpe med at forudsige egenskaberne ved træ! Dette initiativ kan virkelig revolutionere træindustrien og bidrage til en mere bæredygtig udvikling. Med bedre viden om materialet kan vi optimere både produktion og anvendelse. Hvordan ser du potentialet for implementering af disse teknologier i træindustrien?
